response.note: Attempt-level success rate per month for July and August 2026; assumes the status value for a successful attempt is 'SUCCESS'.
response.sql: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', created_at), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50
